name: nanotechnology
description: Nanotechnology: the scaling laws and which forces matter at the nanoscale, quantum confinement and tunnelling, top-down fabrication and lithography, bottom-up synthesis and self-assembly, the semiconductor process and what a node name actually means, characterization methods, nanomaterials (carbon, 2D materials, nanoparticles and their optics), DNA nanotechnology, nanomedicine, computational nanoscience from DFT through machine-learned interatomic potentials, and nanoparticle safety and environmental behaviour.
